title: Jesus – What Does It Mean To Be Guided By Him? – Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences
fullTitle: Soul Feast #77: Jesus – What Does It Mean To Be Guided By Him? – Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences

promo.text: Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world. Start your journey to multisensory perception HERE

description: In this Soul Feast Gary Zukav shares a transformative revelation of his journey into multi-sensory perception: the discovery that he is a student under the direct guidance of Jesus Christ. From his initial repulsion – rooted in the frightened parts of his personality and the historical violence and hypocrisy of institutional religion – to the moment Jesus connected and spoke to him directly as a compadre and equal, Gary traces the arc of a relationship that cracked his heart wide open.
For Gary, the word “Christian” carried the heavy energy of the five-sensory human experience – the Crusades, the Inquisition, and the use of power as a weapon of control.
When Genesis delivered the announcement of his guidance, every frightened part of his personality rose up in resistance. Yet, beneath that fear, something else was quietly stirring.

The resolution came not through doctrine, but through direct experience. Jesus met Gary as an equal – a presence so sweet and tender that it dissolved the walls created by the frightened part of his personality. In that moment, the choice to close his heart became an impossibility, replaced by a permanent alignment with unconditional love.

Think of something you’ve resisted – not because of what it truly is, but because of what the label carried. A word, a tradition, an identity so loaded with history that you couldn’t see past it. What if beneath that label lived something entirely different from what you feared? What parts of your spiritual journey have been shaped – or held back – by the weight of inherited associations? And what might open in you if you were willing to encounter it directly, without the armor of the past?
